lede: Call during school hours and a person will answer.

visiting.heading: Visiting campus
visiting.text: Westside Baptist Academy is a closed campus. All visitors sign in at the main office, entering through the main front doors, and wear a badge while on campus.

employment.heading: Employment
employment.text: Westside Baptist Academy hires teachers who share the convictions of this ministry.

servicesNote: Visitors are welcome at any service.
